The Confirm dialog is a Material dialog on the `{colors.parent-raised}` background with 28 dp corners. Its title uses `{typography.parent-title}` and its body uses `{typography.parent-body}`. It has an Equal choice pair, "Keep" / "Delete". The pair is two tonal Parent buttons of the same size, style and weight, with the keeping option first. "Delete" names exactly what is deleted, and the dialog uses no danger color (NFR-18). Deletions ask for the PIN first, and the "within 30 days" wording is an assumption (CQ-17). The "Delete everything" copy says the model files stay, and that copy lives in EXPERIENCE.md under Parent-area states > Delete everything. I didn't open EXPERIENCE.md to check it.
